newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to drift off before heading up.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to drift off before heading up.

text.p: U.S. T-bond futures are running out of steam near term and will fall back to test support around 107-20 near term before heading back up towards 109-00, technical analysts said on Monday.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst near Cambridge, said resistance around 108-08 would cap the market near term.

Then resistance-turned-support at 107-28 would provide an initial prop, followed by more critical support at 107-20, the top of a gap on hourly chats which stretches down to around 107-16, said Gifford.
By 0918 GMT, the June T-bond contract was up 4/32 at 108-04. The 30-year cash bond was at 94.20 to yield 7.06 percent, from 94.21 in Tokyo and 94.22 at the New York close.

"Although it looks like the market wants to go higher in due course...I'm quietly bearish for now," said Gifford, adding these levels could be seen as a buying opportunity on a slightly longer term view.
"I have no problem at all with 109-00...in around one week's time," she said. Gerry Celaya expected T-bonds to correct higher on Monday.

"We had a good close on Friday and will try to build on that. European bonds have had a bit of a mixed start but that shouldn't affect T-bonds too much and we look for them to go up to 108-07 resistance," he said.
That level marked the low on March 18 and is also the high so far in April at 108-07.
Above there Celaya said there was a cluster of resistance around 108-15 to 108-18. Those levels reflect various lows in mid-March.
"Overall we think this move should go to 109-00 over the next few sessions," he said.
To the downside, he said support was offered at 107-27 to 107-24. Those levels were the high on April 15 and the low on April 18 respectively.
"If we get below there, there is a cluster of minor lows around 107-14 to 12 and then 106-29 to 24," Celaya said.
